summary: The reader has an undergraduate computer science education: asymptotic analysis, discrete mathematics with modular arithmetic and primes, introductory linear algebra and probability-free algorithm design (divide and conquer, sorting, recursion with recurrences), complex numbers and polynomials, and basic Turing machines with tapes. They have likely seen the idea of the FFT only in passing, if at all, and have not studied abstract algebra, harmonic analysis, numerical error analysis or the Harvey-van der Hoeven line of work.

known.name: Euler's formula and roots of unity
known.gloss: e^{iθ}=cos θ+i sin θ, and e^{2πi/q} is a primitive q-th root of unity whose powers sum to zero unless the exponent is a multiple of q.

known.name: Modular arithmetic and divisibility
known.gloss: Arithmetic of integers modulo m, with greatest common divisors, coprimality and modular inverses.

known.name: Chinese remainder theorem
known.gloss: For pairwise coprime moduli, residues modulo each determine a unique residue modulo their product.

known.name: Prime numbers
known.gloss: Integers greater than 1 with no divisors other than 1 and themselves, with unique factorization of every integer into primes.

known.name: Binary representation and bit operations
known.gloss: Integers written in base 2 as bit strings, with bitwise exclusive-or and splitting of bit strings into fields.

known.name: Radix-b representation of integers
known.gloss: Writing an integer as a sum of digits times powers of a base b.

known.name: Schoolbook carry addition and multiplication
known.gloss: Digit-by-digit addition with carries in linear time and quadratic-time long multiplication of integers.

known.name: Divide and conquer recurrences
known.gloss: Solving running-time recurrences for algorithms that split a problem into smaller subproblems and combine results.

known.name: Logarithms and exponentials
known.gloss: Base-2 and natural logarithms, exponent laws, and the growth of powers of logarithms.

known.name: Sums, products and summation manipulation
known.gloss: Finite sums and products with index manipulation and geometric series.

known.name: Vectors, matrices and linear maps
known.gloss: Finite-dimensional vector spaces over the reals or complex numbers, matrices as linear maps, invertibility and bases.

known.name: Subspaces, dimension and rank
known.gloss: Subspaces of a vector space, their dimension, and the rank of a matrix or linear map.

known.name: Vector norms and the max norm
known.gloss: Size of a vector measured by its largest coordinate magnitude, with the triangle inequality.

known.name: Permutations and bijections
known.gloss: Bijections of a finite index set, used to reorder arrays.

known.name: Multidimensional arrays and index tuples
known.gloss: Arrays indexed by tuples, flattened into linear storage in lexicographic order.

known.name: Floating and fixed-point approximation and rounding
known.gloss: Representing real numbers approximately by a finite number of bits and rounding to nearby values.

known.name: Floor, ceiling and rounding functions
known.gloss: Largest integer not exceeding x and smallest integer not less than x.

known.name: Real analysis basics: inequalities and exponential decay
known.gloss: Elementary calculus facts about exponentials and the Gaussian function, and bounding sums and tails of series.

known.name: Dyadic rationals
known.gloss: Rational numbers whose denominator is a power of two, hence finite binary fractions.

known.name: Cyclic and negacyclic indexing
known.gloss: Indexing positions modulo q so that shifts wrap around, as with cyclic shifts of a list.

known.name: Time complexity of sorting and merging on tapes
known.gloss: Sorting n items in O(n log n) steps, which on tapes is done by merging sequential passes.
